claims.statement: For every ordinary tree T of order 14 with p=6 satisfying x(T)+2<=6 and 18<2alpha(T)+1, the full fixed-selector aggregate S(T,6) is at most -222; equality occurs.
claims.scope: Bounded exact computation on all unlabeled ordinary trees of order 14, the p=6 instance of |T|=2p+2. It is not a universal statement over the first-order shell.
claims.reason: The pinned complete free-tree enumeration reports 240 eligible order-14 classes; all 240 complete sums were independently replayed by subset enumeration. The finite convex-hull LP over these realizable columns has exact optimum -222. The generation boundary, eligible columns and source pins are recorded in EVIDENCE.json.

limitations: The fixed p=6 order-14 census does not prove the first-order shell for arbitrary p or settle the primary aggregate.
The LP uses an enumerated finite class list rather than a compact rooted-component formulation; no universal dual certificate or positive realizable witness was obtained.
